pose: Full body side profile in a 1:1 square frame. A small, vibrant Velociraptor with fluffy, colorful feathers in a 'Karate Kid' crane pose. One hind leg is raised high to clearly display a thick, blunt, rounded sickle claw. A ladybug is perched on the tip of the rounded claw. Friendly smirk and soulful eyes. Standard framing with minimal safety margin to maximize character size.
